name: Vilaflor via San Miguel
description: The medium mountain day from the southern resorts: a steady climb through San Miguel to Vilaflor, Spain's highest village, and a long flowing descent home. 63 km.

name: Vilaflor Loop
description: 85 km from Adeje climbing to Vilaflor through the pine forest and returning along the quieter western slopes — the standard Teide-foothills training loop.

name: Teide via Vilaflor and Chío
description: The signature day: up through Vilaflor into the Teide National Park past the cable car at over 2,300 m, then down via Chío. 117 km and 2,800 m on the longest climb in Europe.

name: Masca Loop
description: Short but mighty: 49 km from Santiago del Teide through the famous Masca gorge road — relentless ramps, hairpins and the most dramatic scenery on the island.

name: Montaña Negra Loop
description: The friendlier northwest loop from Santiago del Teide around Montaña Negra — 51 km through lava fields and pine forest without the big-mountain gradients.

name: Anaga Loop
description: The other Tenerife: 47 km through the ancient laurel forests and ridgeline roads of the Anaga mountains in the island's north. Constant climbing, unforgettable riding.

name: Vilaflor Easy Loop
description: The gentlest way up: 47 km to Vilaflor at a steady gradient — as close to an easy day as the south of Tenerife offers.

name: Teide Gentle Loop
description: 92 km circuit of the volcano's southern flank using the steadier gradients — the Teide experience without the steepest ramps.
